semiconductor_relevance: High — Pfeiffer Vacuum provides essential vacuum solutions and measurement equipment critical for various semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Pfeiffer Vacuum (Shanghai) Co., Ltd specializes in providing turbomolecular and dry vacuum pumps, as well as measurement equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes such as PVD, CVD, and lithography. They also offer leak detectors and contamination management systems, making them a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector.
capabilities: Turbomolecular vacuum pumps for PVD and CVD applications
Dry vacuum pumps for lithography and etch processes
Low-vibration vacuum solutions for inspection and metrology

regional_presence.China: Pfeiffer Vacuum operates in Shanghai, providing localized support and solutions for the semiconductor industry.
